brief:
**Justin Sucks League (Yahoo), week 4.** You're **2-1, 3rd place, 2nd in total points (429.4)**. Playoffs: 6 teams, seeded by record.

**This week:** vs **stop harrison me** (2-1, 6th). Yahoo projects **124.3 to 125.3**, a **49%** win chance. A true coin flip.

*League data read from Yahoo through your browser on Tue Sep 29. Projections are Yahoo's (powered by RotoWire).*

### Your players
- **Bryce Young (QB, CAR) vs DET, Sunday night.** Projected 22.2 in a 6-point passing TD league; 291 yards last week.
- **Bo Nix (QB, DEN) at SF.** Projected 21.2, nearly identical to Young. That makes him your best trade chip (see Trades).
- **Luther Burden III (WR, CHI) vs NYJ.** 7-61-1 last week; Chicago is home against the Jets.
- **Juwan Johnson (TE, NO) vs ATL, Monday night.** 8 catches and 2 TDs last week; NFL.com's top TE pickup this week.
- **Dallas Goedert (TE, PHI)** is doubtful; he sat Week 3 with a knee injury (Philadelphia Inquirer).
- **Jadarian Price (RB, SEA).** Just 1.2 points last week with a lost fumble. Your weakest starter.
- **Steelers D/ST plays Thursday night** at Cleveland; it locks then.

### Waiver news that affects you
- **Your pending claim: add Braelon Allen, drop MarShawn Lloyd** (processes Sep 30). Breece Hall is week to week with a quad injury (ESPN), so Allen should lead the Jets backfield. Good claim.
- **Ollie Gordon II is still available.** De'Von Achane is out for the season (NFL.com).

### Your opponent (stop harrison me)
- **Nico Collins (HOU)** is questionable; ESPN's Adam Schefter reports a decent chance he returns vs Dallas (NBC Sports).
- **Puka Nacua (LAR)** is also questionable, in their FLEX.
- **Trevor Lawrence** faces a Cincinnati defense allowing the 3rd-most passing yards (ESPN).
- If Collins or Nacua sits, their fill-ins are Chris Godwin or Khalil Shakir, a big drop.

- **Sunday ~8:30am:** inactives for 10am games (Flowers, Burden).
waivers:
Waivers here are a **rolling list, and you're 9th**. A claim moves you to the bottom, so save it for players who matter.

| Priority | Add | Why | Drop |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Braelon Allen** (RB, NYJ) — already pending | Breece Hall is week to week (ESPN); Allen should lead the backfield. | MarShawn Lloyd |
| 2 | **Ollie Gordon II** (RB, MIA) | Achane's season-ending ACL opens the job; Gordon scored in relief (NFL.com). | Marvin Harrison Jr. |
| 3 | **Kalif Raymond** (WR, CHI) | 23.1% target share, 6-90-1 last week (NFL.com). Only if you need WR depth. | Wan'Dale Robinson |

### Why drop Marvin Harrison Jr.?
He has one decent game (3-40) and is being outplayed by teammate Michael Wilson (ESPN). You have more reliable WRs, and RB is your weak spot.

### Hold
- **Dallas Goedert:** knee injury, but a starting-caliber TE when healthy. You have the bench room.
- **Bo Nix:** trade him rather than drop him.
trades:
### Your roster: surplus and needs
- **Surplus: QB.** Bryce Young and Bo Nix project almost identically (22.2 and 21.2). You only start one.
- **Surplus: WR depth.** Wan'Dale Robinson (18.7 last week) and Marvin Harrison Jr.
- **Need: RB2.** Behind Ashton Jeanty you have Jadarian Price, Woody Marks and MarShawn Lloyd.
- **Trade deadline:** Nov 28. The commissioner reviews trades.

### Offers to send

| # | Partner | You give | You get | Why it works for you | Why they'd accept | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Crashee Rice** (1-2) | Bo Nix | **Bhayshul Tuten** (RB, JAX) or **RJ Harvey** (RB, DEN) | A real RB2/flex option for a player you don't start. | They carry four RBs, and their backup QB Baker Mayfield is out, leaving Dak Prescott with no cover. | Medium |
| 2 | **LionsWonAgain** (1-2) | Bo Nix | **Breece Hall** (RB, NYJ) — buy-low | Hall is week to week (ESPN). If your Braelon Allen claim hits, you'd own the whole Jets backfield. | Their backup QB Jayden Daniels has a dislocated elbow and may sit again (RotoWire). They also have five RBs. | Medium |
| 3 | **Mixon round 1 K.O** (1-2) | Bo Nix + Wan'Dale Robinson | **Alvin Kamara** (RB, NO) | A steady RB2 in PPR. | Josh Allen is listed questionable with a knee bruise and they have no backup QB. An injury doctor expects Allen to play (SI), so this is weaker. | Low |

**Nix can only go once.** Start with #2 if you want upside, #1 if you want help right now.

### Rival check
The only teams ahead of you are **Deshaun Don’t Touchdown There** (3-0, most points) and **Matt Gay** (3-0). None of the offers above help them.

### Sell high
- **Juwan Johnson:** 2 TDs last week. But he's your starting TE while Goedert is hurt, so hold for now.
- **Wan'Dale Robinson:** 18.7 points last week; package him while his value is up.

### Don't trade
Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Ashton Jeanty, Zay Flowers.
